additional_info.subject: RE: ID0434717-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312534694/05] Power converter issue CRM:02919000067
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0434717 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Please perform below troubleshooting steps:
1.Check for any loose connections in the power cables or CAN communication cables of the converter and measure the voltage across them using a multimeter.
2.Additionally, check the resistance across the CAN communication cables. Verify the status of the power converter display—whether it is in the OFF or ON state.
3.Consider swapping the power converter with a functional one. If the error flag shifts to the replaced unit, it suggests that the original converter may be faulty.
4.If all the steps have been performed and the power converter is still found to be faulty, we recommend replacing it, as rework is not feasible. Please ensure electrical safety and adhere to PPE guidelines. Additionally, you may refer the attached troubleshooting document.
Also refer the KA for your reference:
1.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_PowerConverter_ CanCommLoss error - Dynamics 365
2.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - Dynamics 365
